> Clean by construction: a short project brief.

The onboarding flow has six screens and analytics says four of them lose more
people than they inform. Before we redesign anything, I want one week of
session recordings on the two screens that survive, so we know what the
successful path actually looks like rather than what we assume it looks like.

If the recordings say the same as the funnel, we cut four screens. If they
disagree, we find out why before touching the design.
